tuesday.label: Lower A (Quads / Hamstrings / Glutes)
tuesday.warmup: 5–7 min easy recumbent bike or flat walk, left arm relaxed. No rowing, bands or arm-supported drills. Continue only if symptoms are stable/improving and setup is comfortable without left-hand gripping. One very light practice set per machine; keep at least 4 reps in reserve. Stop any movement that provokes the forearm.
tuesday.cooldown: 3–5 min easy flat walk, then comfortable seated breathing with the left arm supported. Follow clinician-directed gentle elbow movement only. No forearm stretches, doorway stretches, quadruped positions, planks or generic video substitutions. No pressure through the left hand/elbow.

exercises.notes: Provisional light starting pin, no prior baseline. Use the lightest comfortable pin and enter its actual weight. Left arm relaxed; do not copy pictured handle gripping. Skip if safe setup or stabilization needs the left hand. Keep 4+ reps in reserve; no increases this week.

Reduced from prior 75–85-lb work. Thigh pad must stabilize you without left-hand gripping; this week's cue overrides the generic handle-grip instruction. If the machine requires both hands, skip it. Reduce weight for any strain; 4+ reps in reserve.

Reduced from prior 95-lb work. Comfortable middle range, no torso rocking. Left arm relaxed, no handle grip or arm brace; skip if needed for safe use. Stop if hip/groin pain returns. No progression this week.
No dumbbell, barbell or band. Left arm comfortably supported, no pressing into mat. Small comfortable lift through the feet, breathe normally. Omit if getting down/up needs the injured arm.

wednesday.label: Cardio + Right-Arm Upper + Core A
wednesday.warmup: 20 min easy recumbent bike or flat walking total = 5 min very easy + 12 min steady + 3 min easing down. RPE 2–3; left arm relaxed, no gripping or railing support. Then optional supported RIGHT-arm machine work only if staff confirms safe independent-arm operation and all setup/repetitions leave the left arm idle. Choose an easy actual load after a very light practice set; leave at least 4 reps in reserve. If either machine is unsuitable, omit it. Record actual cardio minutes and symptom response.
wednesday.cooldown: The 3-min easing-down phase is already included in the cardio block. Finish with seated relaxed breathing, left arm supported. No left-arm stretches, resistance, hand/elbow-supported floor positions or generic cooldown substitutions.

exercises.notes: OPTIONAL, RIGHT ONLY. Staff must confirm independent one-arm use; back supported, no trunk rotation, left arm rests without gripping or bracing. Skip if setup or safe use requires the left arm; no Smith/dumbbell substitute. Perform 10–12 controlled reps with 4+ in reserve, enter actual load/reps, no progression. Image shows bilateral reference; do not copy left-arm use. Stop for any forearm increase.

OPTIONAL, RIGHT ONLY. Independent machine arm and chest support required; left arm rests, never holds the spare handle or seat. Ask for setup help; skip if left-arm support or torso twisting is needed. Perform 10–12 controlled reps with 4+ in reserve, log actual load/reps, no progression. Image shows bilateral reference; written variation controls. Omit if symptoms rise during or after.

Optional if floor entry/exit is safe without left-hand/elbow support. 12 alternating reps total = 6 per leg; comfortable bent-knee heel taps with both arms resting. No arm reach or pressure into floor. Skip if setup or movement provokes the forearm.

thursday.label: Lower B (Repeat Comfortable Loads)
thursday.warmup: 5–7 min easy bike or flat walk with left arm relaxed. Tuesday caused no reported forearm or hip/groin pain increase during or afterward; repeat the listed actual loads only if symptoms also stayed at baseline the next morning and before this session. One very light practice set per machine. Keep 4+ reps in reserve. If there was delayed worsening, reduce or omit the provoking exercise; do not make up sets. No left-hand gripping or arm brace.
thursday.cooldown: 3–5 min easy flat walk and comfortable seated breathing with left arm supported. No forced forearm stretch, hand-held quad stretch, quadruped position or arm-supported cooldown. Follow only the clinician’s gentle elbow-motion guidance.

exercises.notes: Repeat Tuesday’s actual load as a ceiling, only after a stable next-morning response. Use less if needed for 4+ reps in reserve. Left arm relaxed; no copying the image’s handle grip. Skip if safe setup or stabilization needs the left hand. No load/rep/set progression.

Repeat Tuesday’s actual load, or less, if the forearm remains at baseline. Thigh pad must stabilize you without left-hand gripping; skip if the machine requires both hands. No grinding or increases; leave 4+ reps in reserve.

Tuesday’s actual load is the ceiling. Comfortable middle range, no torso rocking or left-arm grip/brace. Reduce for any strain and stop for returning hip/groin or forearm symptoms. Repeat only after a stable next-morning check.

Repeat Tuesday’s actual 80 × 12 × 3; the prior hip/groin issue is fully resolved per Jonathan. Use a comfortable range and leave 4+ reps in reserve. Left arm rests; this overrides generic handle-grip instructions. Skip if setup or safe use needs the left arm, or if forearm symptoms increase. No load/rep/set progression.
